steps.note: Give them a few days before reaching out

steps.subject: We missed you at class
steps.body: Hi {{ first_name }}, we noticed you couldn't make your last class. Life happens! Your spot is always here when you're ready to come back.

true_branch.subject: Still want to get back in?
true_branch.body: Hi {{ first_name }}, your membership is still active. Want us to save you a spot this week?
